faqs.answer: Code Breaker Challenge 2.0 (CBC 2.0) is a technical event organized by the Department of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning at Global Academy of Technology, in collaboration with Dyashin, and supported by IEEE Bangalore Section, IEEE Computer Society Bangalore Chapter, the Institution's Innovation Council, CTFL Codes, and Altron AIML.
Code Breaker Challenge 2.0 will be held on 10th - 11th October 2026.
The event will be held at Global Academy of Technology, Ideal Homes Township, Rajarajeshwari Nagar, Bengaluru - 560098.
The registration fee is ₹1500/- per team.
Each team can have between 2 and 4 members.
There is a total cash pool of ₹60,000 (60K), along with certificates and internship opportunities for participants.
You can register by scanning the QR code on the official event poster. For help, reach out to the registration team listed under contacts.
The event is organized by the Department of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning at Global Academy of Technology (Autonomous), approved by AICTE New Delhi and affiliated to VTU.
Website: https://cbc-2-xv2u.vercel.app/ | Instagram: gatbengaluru | Facebook: GlobalAcademyOfTech
